title: Walk the built-in 3-step execution tour in guided mode
as: An engineer presenting the project to a manager by clicking only the Navigator
goal: In a disposable copy of the doc-pipeline example, start the execution journey tour (orchestrate → process → results), step through its three steps, then present it read-only.
hints: The execution tour is generated from the example's facts: orchestrate orchestrates process, process produces results.
expected: The tour has three numbered steps and each step moves the Navigator to its box with its view.
Present hides the edit controls (save path, add screen) and the jump field.
STEPBAR1: the Steps view lists the journey's steps with their small checks, and Project checks at the end; the Project tree shows no readiness section.
outOfScope: Editing any file outside this disposable copy
